# Forum debate: DE Sidious, Vitiate, Nihilus vs Kaiburr-Crystal Vader, VotJ Jerec, Star Forge Malak, Orbalisk Bane, Artifact Exar Kun (Suspect Insight)

**URL:** https://www.suspectinsightforums.com/t993-de-sidious-vitiate-and-nihilus-vs-kaiburr-crystal-vader-votj-jerec-sf-malak-orbalisk-bane-and-artifact-exar-kun
**Pages read:** 1 of 1 (13 real posts; `t993p20-...` is empty). Raw: `forum-raw/t993.html`. Date: 8-9 Sep 2019.

## Conditions
- Team A: Dark Empire Sidious, Vitiate, Nihilus.
- Team B: Valley of the Jedi Jerec, Kaiburr-crystal Vader, Star Forge Malak, orbalisk-armoured Bane, Exar Kun with Sith artifact.
- The OP later revises it: remove Jerec and Nihilus, so it becomes Vader, Malak, Bane, Kun vs Sidious + Vitiate.

## Arguments
- **Jerec solos:** The Ellimist: "VotJ Jerec was essentially godlike, so he solos everyone else here." Master Azronger posts a Comic Vine–hosted scan (`comicvine1.cbsistatic.com/.../6622574-1637339887-Valle.PNG`, which we did not open) and says "Valley of the Jedi Jerec solos". MasterCilghal and NotAA3 (Guest) agree.
- **Revised fight (no Jerec):**
  - Master Azronger: "both Vader and Bane are canonically far, far beneath Sidious, and the same rings true for Kun and Malak in relation to Vitiate. I'd say the gaps are large enough that the two emperors can one-shot their respective inferiors… And that's without factoring in Force storms".
  - The Ellimist: "Star Forge Malak still lost to a weaker version of the Revan who is below Vitiate."
  - HeartoftheForce asks whether they can "stomp Vader at x1000 power?" (Kaiburr crystal). Azronger replies "RotJ Vader's more powerful than ever". BreakofDawn: "Vader's amp would make a pretty massive difference but he has virtually zero control with it."

## Counterarguments and rebuttals that landed
- The amps (Kaiburr crystal, Star Forge) don't close the gap. Rebuttals: Vader has "virtually zero control" of the Kaiburr amp (BreakofDawn), and SF Malak already lost to a weaker Revan (The Ellimist). Nobody pushed back.

## Verdict tally (POSTER OPINION)
- Original: Jerec's team, by Jerec soloing: 5 (Ellimist, Azronger, MasterCilghal, Guest/NotAA3, BreakofDawn "Jerec sounds OP as hell"; DC77 quoted NotAA3 without comment).
- Revised (no Jerec): Sidious + Vitiate: 2 (Ellimist, Azronger). BreakofDawn: "DE Sidious could win".

## Scaling chains
- Revan (weaker version) > SF Malak; Vitiate > Revan, so Vitiate >> SF Malak (Ellimist).
- Sidious >> Vader and Bane "canonically" (Azronger).

## Conflicts with our notes
- Our notes have no VotJ Jerec file, so the "godlike Jerec" claim is unverified locally.
- Vitiate > Revan (Reborn) is supported in direction by `vitiate-comicvine-respect-part1.txt`: "the Emperor was infinitely more powerful than Darth Nyriss had ever been." That passage is from Revan Reborn's fight with Vitiate.
